description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Order Callout all the members of the Armed Forces with effect from 22.03.2023
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it is an order made under existing legislation (Chapter 40) and establishes legal authority for military deployment, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
